pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with softened, rounded vertices. The patches on the mid-flank exhibit a larger relative spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly trifurcated. The pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The geometric contour is present but displays soft pixel gradients due to image resolution.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five dark avian organisms (Oxpeckers) clinging to the pelage at the upper neck, mid-dorsal ridge, rump, and ventral midline.
